The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
https://paperclip.ing

  
 
 Quickstart · Docs · GitHub · Discord · Twitter · Website 
 
     
 
 
 
  
 
 
Paperclip is the app people use to manage AI agents for work.
 
Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents.
 
If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company.
 
Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs

items.title: Show HN: Prodigy – The Self-Updating Technical Digest
items.contentSnippet:
I've seen newsletters where we have 15-20 people working on typing out the content and publish it. Obviously that gives you originality, but what if we don't have that much time and resources?
I made Prodigy, a self-updating AI newsletter that fetches the best technical updates from sources like X, Hacker News, Git and top-conference papers. items.title: Show HN: HomeAI.design – Visualize interior design ideas from a photo
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
I’m an indie developer and I recently built HomeAI.design.
The original idea was simple. When people renovate a room, it's difficult to imagine what a different design would actually look like in their own space.
So I built a tool where you upload a room photo and generate different interior design ideas.
I'm still figuring out what users really need, especially compared with other AI interior design tools.
Would love feedback on the product and the generated results.

items.contentSnippet:
